# Coffee Reads

Coffee Reads is a premium digital book store providing high-quality educational materials and guides.

## Products Available
- The Ultimate Claude 3.5 Sonnet Guide (The complete masterclass on using Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet AI)
- Divorced Dad's Guide to Winning Custody (English)
- Divorced Dad's Guide to Winning Custody (Hindi)

## Payment & Delivery
Payments are processed securely via Razorpay. Upon successful payment, customers immediately receive a direct download link for the PDF via email.
